participation.scopeWeight: Shares use cumulative responsibility time, so longer work items carry more weight. Periods without samples are left blank and do not mean zero duration.
participation.scopeSharedSource: Same source as Average duration under Pipeline health on the realtime dashboard: a shared T+1 snapshot fact layer, with a live tail for today.

participation.insightRatio: The distribution is right-skewed: the mean of {{average}} is {{ratio}}× the median of {{median}}, pulled up by a few slow-tail work items.

members.method: Tasks belong to their current human owner; Agent tasks belong to the assigning operator. Unassigned tasks and historical members are listed separately. Tasks are deduplicated by work item ID. The scope covers tasks created or having events or execution activity in the selected period. Completed follows the dashboard definition of successful delivery during the period; in progress, not started and pending decision/review use the unified dashboard categories (IN_PROGRESS, NEW, PENDING_DECISION) and exclude tasks completed in the period, so the four columns are mutually exclusive. Total tasks excludes canceled tasks and may be larger than the sum of the four columns. Requirements delivered count only REQ. Times are in Beijing time.

model.bottleneckBody: Waiting signals are elevated over {{date}}, mainly around post-handoff state synchronization and incomplete review evidence.
model.anomalyRising: Anomaly intensity rose above the baseline over {{date}}, driven mainly by changes in retry and rejection shares.
model.anomalyFalling: Anomaly intensity fell below the baseline over {{date}}, driven mainly by changes in retry and rejection shares.

model.recommendSync: {{worker}}: prioritize handoff synchronization and review evidence in SDLC records over {{date}} to avoid state changes without progress updates.
model.recommendWait: {{worker}}: after a review rejection, wait for a new review request before continuing to reduce repeated polling.
model.recommendAcceptance: {{worker}}: add a secondary acceptance field to frequently blocked workflows to distinguish running, awaiting decision and completed states.
model.recommendAudit: {{worker}}: increase audit sampling on anomaly days, focusing on whether retries, reopen events and state changes occur in pairs.

comparison.totalMethod: Add recorded stage intervals within each execution first, then calculate average, P50 or P90 across complete executions. Gaps between stages are excluded. A complete execution must succeed and cover every required stage in its recorded SDLC configuration.
comparison.slowestNote: The 10 executions with the longest recorded total stage time are shown. Partial executions may be included. Missing durations display “—”.
comparison.mixedConfigurations: Each worker version may use several SDLC configurations. Choose one from each side to inspect the changes.
comparison.missingConfiguration: A verified configuration is missing on one side; changes cannot be determined.
comparison.sameConfiguration: The selected SDLC configurations are identical.
comparison.differentWorkflows: These configurations belong to different workflows and cannot describe a configuration change.

stages.title: Stage duration
stages.filtersFailure: Could not load filters. Please retry.
stages.empty: No stage records in this range. Adjust the dates or filters.
stages.scope: Samples are selected by execution creation date (Asia/Shanghai). Squad filtering uses current membership. Each execution counts separately; a workitem may have several executions.
stages.coverageDetail: Coverage is calculated over executions with stage records. Stage samples missing a start ({{missing}}), executions without stage records ({{noStage}}) and executions without an applicable workflow ({{notApplicable}}) are counted separately.
stages.oversized: This flow has many runs and may load slowly
stages.method: Stage totals follow actual execution boundaries. Later business updates do not extend interrupted work; tails without stop evidence remain separately unknown. External blocking uses interval unions without subtracting concurrent processing, full task lifetimes or reused work twice. Adjusted time still includes unknown time and is not pure SDLC processing. The table shows the mean, P50 and P90 of recorded durations for completed stages. Running, failed, canceled and reworked costs remain visible. Historical time without classification evidence stays unknown; unavailable external blocking displays “—”.
stages.slowestNote: The 10 longest executions for each stage are shown. Missing durations display “—”. Open the workitem to inspect its execution records.
stages.operationsOmitted: Operation groups omitted from the summary ({{groups}}) can be inspected in the execution trace.
stages.operationNote: Recorded services and operations are shown below. Cumulative call times can overlap and must not be summed as external blocking. External task lifetime is distinct from actual blocking. Inspect the workitem execution trace for individual calls and task correlation.
stages.waitMethod: For each completed stage, subtract confirmed external blocking and other known waits before calculating the median, P90 or average. Unknown time stays in the result. Historical runs without timing data contribute their full observed duration. Coverage is the classified share of elapsed time including unobserved tails. The tail is estimated from the last dispatch-record update, which may occur after execution ends. It is excluded from observed duration and quantile statistics.
stages.adjustedSlowest: Up to 10 executions, longest time after known waits first.

timeline.title: Stage durations
timeline.stageMethod: Stage metrics use completed stages with effective timings. Fewer than 5 effective samples are marked as few samples. Sample counts may differ by stage; percentiles cannot be added. Observed differences are not causal effects. Matched comparisons in the configuration details additionally require the same verified configuration.

cohorts.versionScope: Up to {{limit}} latest executions per version within the selected dates
cohorts.exclusions: Only completed stages with valid durations enter the metric. Unobserved, running, incomplete, reused, skipped and missing timings are excluded, never counted as zero. The sum of stage durations for complete executions is supplementary and is not end-to-end elapsed time.
cohorts.empty: No execution samples within the selected dates.
cohorts.noStageEvents: These executions have no stage records yet.
cohorts.dailyMethod: Both views share execution creation dates (Beijing time). The SDLC configuration view includes all worker versions within that range. Each execution counts separately. Historical executions with unknown versions remain included.
cohorts.versionMethod: Within the selected dates, the worker version view independently takes the latest 30 executions bound to each selected version, or all if fewer exist. Changing dates preserves selected versions, including those with no samples. Executions are selected before valid stage timings; incomplete and untimed executions remain in the denominator. Each card shows the dates of its actual selected executions.
cohorts.stageQuality: Observed ({{observed}}). Executions outside this metric ({{excluded}}) include stages that never ran, were skipped or have no timing. These cases also occur in successful executions with complete telemetry.
cohorts.executionQuality: {{label}} · Total executions ({{all}}) · Complete ({{complete}}) · Summed stage durations (P50 {{p50}}, P90 {{p90}}, average {{average}}).
cohorts.historyNote: Historical configurations come from execution snapshots. Effective timings with missing snapshots remain in observational comparisons; matched comparisons require verified configurations. Current configuration never replaces history. Actual usage order does not imply release or upgrade order.
cohorts.configurationChartNote: Only this workflow is compared. Configurations are ordered by their latest execution, with the four most recently used selected by default. Reused configurations do not imply release order; missing timings show “—”.
cohorts.changedFromPrevious: Whole workflow configuration differences from the configuration before first use in this range: {{fields}}
cohorts.noEarlierConfiguration: No verified configuration was observed before this configuration's first use in this range.
cohorts.unverifiedTimingHint: These unverified executions may use different configurations. Their timings summarize this execution set, not one shared configuration. Valid / total samples counts effective timings among selected executions; it is not stage applicability or telemetry coverage.

evolution.noBaseline: This worker has no other version with executions yet. Current performance is shown without a difference.
evolution.noComparableStages: No stage in this workflow has comparable timings on both sides under the selected time basis. Missing values mean neither zero time nor a removed stage.
evolution.smallSampleHint: Fewer than 5 effective samples: treat these values as observations. This cue is not a significance test or confidence interval; check the sample mix.
evolution.stageIdentityNote: Stages are matched by identity within the same workflow, never by name alone. Active, failed, skipped and missing timings are not zero. Stage percentiles cannot be added.
evolution.conditionDetailsNote: Each configuration lists all three metrics and effective sample counts. Differences here require effective timings for both versions within the same verified configuration. Configurations with only one version remain visible.
evolution.unidentifiedStages_one: {{count}} stage record has no verified stage identity and cannot be matched across configurations. Its timing remains in the configuration details.
evolution.unidentifiedStages_other: {{count}} stage records have no verified stage identities and cannot be matched across configurations. Their timings remain in the configuration details.

configurationDetails.noSharedHint: These versions have no shared verified configuration. The overview summarizes each version across its configurations; details list actual executions per configuration.
